title: Planned annual Malecón gathering for Human Rights Day, Dec. 10 (not verified as executed)
reason: The reporting says the organizer was arrested at home on Dec. 8 to prevent attendance at the annual call to meet on Dec. 10. No public gathering or attendance at the Malecón is documented, so this is a prevented/planned event, not an executed protest.

title: Marcha del Pueblo Combatiente at the U.S. embassy, Dec. 20
reason: Reuters reports a mass public march led by Raúl Castro and President Díaz-Canel, demanding action from the U.S. government on U.S. sanctions and its terrorism-sponsor designation of Cuba. It targets a foreign government’s policy, not the Cuban state or its policy, and is an officially led pro-government march; excluded under the own-country-state target criterion.
